context_requirements: NR5A2 expression and functional activity in the assayed cell line
a transcriptional program dependent on NR5A2 that is active at baseline
the 978 landmark gene set must include NR5A2-dependent target genes
falsifiers: reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression after treatment in any of the nine cell lines
a shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines at 6 h or 24 h
changes in NR5A2-dependent liver or cholesterol-related genes in HEPG2 or other lines
